date.description: The date the post was published, in the site's timezone.

date_gmt.description: The date the post was published, as GMT.

guid.description: The globally unique identifier for the post.

raw.description: GUID for the post, as it exists in the database. Only present when using the 'edit' context.

rendered.description: GUID for the post, transformed for display.

modified.description: The date the post was last modified, in the site's timezone.

modified_gmt.description: The date the post was last modified, as GMT.

slug.description: An alphanumeric identifier for the post unique to its type.

status.description: A named status for the post.

type.description: Type of Post for the post.

password.description: A password to protect access to the content and excerpt. Only present when using the 'edit' context.

parent.description: The ID for the parent of the post. Only present for hierarchical post types.

menu_order.description: A field used for ordering posts.

raw.description: Title for the post, as it exists in the database. Only present when using the 'edit' context.

rendered.description: HTML title for the post, transformed for display.

raw.description: Content for the post, as it exists in the database. Only present when using the 'edit' context.

rendered.description: HTML content for the post, transformed for display.

block_version.description: Version of the content block format used by the post. Only present when using the 'edit' context.

protected.description: Whether the content is protected with a password.

featured_media.description: The ID of the featured media for the post.

sticky.description: Whether or not the post should be treated as sticky. Only present for the 'post' post type.

template.description: The theme file to use to display the post.

categories.description: The terms assigned to the post in the category taxonomy. Only present for post types that support categories.

tags.description: The terms assigned to the post in the post_tag taxonomy. Only present for post types that support tags.
